app_info.subtitle: Manage Render resources
app_info.description: Render helps users inspect services, deploys, logs, and metrics; create services and data stores; query Render Postgres databases; trigger deployments; and manage environment variables through ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists accessible workspaces and may persist the sole workspace as the active session selection.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes a private MCP session selection and does not publish or message externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Persists the selected Render workspace in the current MCP session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes private session state and does not alter a Render resource or public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Changes the active workspace selection without deleting or overwriting Render resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the workspace currently selected in the MCP session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change public internet state or any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves services visible in the selected Render workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change Render resources or public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves details for the specified Render service.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change Render resources or public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new Render web service and may start its initial deployment.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates an externally hosted service that can be publicly reachable on the internet.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new resource without deleting or overwriting an existing Render resource.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new Render static site and may start its initial deployment.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates a publicly reachable site hosted on Render's global CDN.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new resource without deleting or overwriting an existing Render resource.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a scheduled Render cron job that runs the configured command.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates and schedules a workload in the user's external Render account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new resource without deleting or overwriting an existing Render resource.

justifications.read_only_justification: Writes environment variables to a Render service and triggers the associated configuration update.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes service configuration in the user's external Render account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Replace mode overwrites the complete environment-variable set and can remove existing values.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves deployment history for the specified Render service.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not trigger deployments or change Render resources.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves details for a specified service deployment.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not trigger deployments or change Render resources.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts a new deployment for the specified Render service.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can replace the version of a service available through its external Render deployment.
justifications.destructive_justification: A deployment can replace the currently running version, and clear-cache mode also discards build cache state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves Postgres instances visible in the selected Render workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not create or change a database or public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves metadata for the specified Render Postgres instance.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not create or change a database or public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new Postgres instance in the selected Render workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates a managed database in the user's external Render account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new database without deleting or overwriting an existing resource.

justifications.read_only_justification: Executes SQL inside a database transaction explicitly configured as read-only.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only retrieves database results and does not change Render resources or public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: The read-only transaction prevents queries from mutating or deleting database records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves Key Value instances visible in the selected Render workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not create or change a data store or public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves metadata for the specified Render Key Value instance.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not create or change a data store or public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new Key Value instance in the selected Render workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates a managed data store in the user's external Render account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new data store without deleting or overwriting an existing resource.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves logs matching the supplied resource, time, and label filters.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write logs, change Render resources, or alter public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves available values for a log label under the supplied filters.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write logs, change Render resources, or alter public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves time-series performance metrics for the specified Render resource.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change resource configuration or public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

test_cases.description: Create a web service from a repository with explicit runtime commands.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a free Node web service named example-api from my repository, build it with npm ci, and start it with npm start.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates the web service with the requested configuration and returns its Render resource details.

test_cases.description: Investigate recent errors using bounded log filters.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show error-level logs for service srv-example from the last hour, newest first.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching recent error logs for the specified service and time window.

test_cases.description: Inspect CPU and memory usage for capacity analysis.
test_cases.user_prompt: Get CPU and memory usage for srv-example over the last two hours at five-minute resolution.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns timestamped CPU and memory measurements for the requested period and resolution.

test_cases.description: Run a read-only aggregate query against Render Postgres.
test_cases.user_prompt: On Postgres instance dpg-example, count orders grouped by status without changing any data.
test_cases.expected_output: Runs the aggregate in a read-only transaction and returns the grouped counts.

test_cases.description: Replace service environment variables as an explicit destructive operation.
test_cases.user_prompt: Replace all environment variables on srv-example with NODE_ENV=production and LOG_LEVEL=info.
test_cases.expected_output: Replaces the service environment-variable set with the two supplied values and reports the resulting update.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for another hosting provider.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: List all of my deployments on Vercel.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it only manages resources hosted on Render.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for a general programming explanation.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Explain how database connection pooling works in Go.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request does not require Render account data or actions.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for an unsupported service deletion.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Permanently delete my Render service srv-example.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not invoke a tool because this MCP server does not expose service deletion.
